products.name: Personalised Pokémon-inspired trading card binder

products.description:
Make your card collection personal with a custom laser-engraved zipped binder. Choose the 4-pocket or 9-pocket format and a colour from the matching Card Guardian chart. products.name: Personalised portrait string-art kit
products.short_description: Build a portrait one thread at a time.
products.description:
A circular string-art project with a prepared frame, thread and a guide, as shown in the kit photograph. Repeated lines gradually reveal a portrait, creating a satisfying handmade display. The gallery includes a completed example and close-ups of the making process.

Made with care in Chepstow

Designed and laser-crafted by our small family workshop. Each piece is checked before it leaves us.

Make it yours

Send the portrait you would like to use. We will discuss whether the photograph is suitable for a string-art design.

For artwork or photo engraving, email your reference to mazeshopsales@gmail.com with the product name. We can discuss the design before making your piece.

Natural materials and engraving tones can vary slightly. Please use the photographs as a guide to the design and finish.

Product details

  • Supplied quantity: 1 portrait string-art kit
  • Material: Laser-cut or engraved wood
  • Indicative finished size: About 30 cm frame diameter
  • Included: Prepared circular frame with pins, black thread, photo-specific numbered threading guide and assembly instructions
  • Not included: Glue, tools and display stand
  • Care: Dust gently with a soft dry cloth; keep away from moisture.

Made to order

Please allow approximately 10–15 working days before dispatch. Sizes are indicative; bespoke layouts and final sizing are agreed before making.
